construction: When the rule ENTERS name s at decision date d, each draw j draws one partner from s's (size band x vol_63 tercile x 12-1 tercile) cell as of d, among names eligible at d with a forward return, not held by the rule and not already a partner in draw j. Seed of draw j = matched_twins.seed_for(rule_id, j). Fallbacks cell -> band_vol -> band -> any, counted.

The partner is held exactly as long as the rule holds s, at s's target weight (EW, ivw, liqw, risk parity alike), with the rule's drift and re-weight-to-target convention (scripts.hyp_investable.run_book).

Redraws: the rule exits s (partner sold, reason exit); the partner is off the panel or has no forward return at a decision date (reason died, redrawn that date); the partner is now held by the rule (reason collision). An unmatched slot holds cash and retries (reason unmatched_retry). Every reason is counted on the receipt.
Both legs pay matched_twins.trade_cost on their own traded weight at the per-name round trip matched_twins.round_trip_spread (TWIN_COST_COMPOSITION).
Draws: 21 (config.STICKY_TWIN_N_DRAWS); twin gross, cost and turnover are the mean over draws.
licence: PRODUCT_EXPERIMENT (a control construction for historical boards; no book, no order, $0 LLM)
printed: beside, never instead of, the basket fair twin and the registered twin21: a separate run id of scripts.hyp_twin_board --twin sticky, every row carrying twin_kind.

receipt_check.rule: median over invested months, EXCLUDING months with a died or collision redraw, of |twin one-way turnover - rule one-way turnover| <= tolerance; else the board row is REFUSED with the gap.

Its per-rule t-values were printed to a log. That run is VOID: it is not read, cited or resumed. The exclusion of death/collision months comes from the adversarial review's spec (docs/reviews/REVIEW_2026-10-06_C1_FAIR_TWIN.md, 'The sticky twin', item 4), not from those refusals; the tolerance 0.03 is unchanged from its first declaration in config.py.
